style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley 6ft Pre-Lit Faux Pencil Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring festive elegance to your home with our 6ft pre-lit faux pencil Christmas tree, the perfect choice for smaller spaces or minimalist styling. Designed with a slender silhouette and realistic green branches, this space-saving solution offers the classic charm of a full-size tree without the hassle. Pre-lit with warm white plug-in lights, it casts a soft, cosy glow that instantly adds warmth to your space. Whether placed in a hallway or beside the fireplace, its slim shape makes it easy to style your way. Simple to assemble and designed for reuse year after year, this tree is a timeless addition to your Christmas décor – bringing festive magic to your home with minimal fuss. ELEGANT SLIM DESIGN: This 180cm Charles Bentley Slim Christmas Tree is perfect for smaller rooms or tighter spaces, offering a tall, graceful silhouette without taking up too much floor space. PRE-LIT WITH WARM WHITE LEDS: Fitted with warm white plug-in LED lights, this tree delivers a soft, ambient glow – ideal for creating a cosy and inviting festive atmosphere with no need for separate lighting. REALISTIC ARTIFICIAL BRANCHES: Crafted with lifelike green PVC branches, this tree captures the look of a traditional fir while remaining mess-free and easy to maintain throughout the season. SIMPLE ASSEMBLY & STORAGE: Designed for quick and easy setup, this tree slots together in sections and disassembles just as easily – making storage stress-free year after year. INDOOR CHRISTMAS DÉCOR: A timeless addition to your seasonal setup, this tree is perfect for hallways, living rooms, or dining areas – bringing festive cheer to any indoor space with minimal fuss. DIMENSIONS: Tree height: 183cm, Tree width: 56cm, Base height: 15cm, Weight: 5.3kg, Cable length: 180cm, with 553 tips. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Plug in power source, Plug type: Type I: 220 - 240 Volt Size: ONE.
